fixture.construction: Evaluate formulas in NumPy float64, round once into stored float32 arrays; no JAX float64 values. Broadcast fixed transition arrays over L.
fixture.semantics: Exact A3WZ formula; Q is covariance, unary J is precision; L=T-1; full support and fixed zero origins.

coordinate.order: all active gauge-reduced constants, all active linear coefficients, all active upper-triangle symmetric precision entries, then active xi; banks ordered side,time,label
coordinate.gauge: first supported constant per incidence is zero
coordinate.inactive: fixed -inf constant support metadata, zero linear/precision; inactive xi exact zero
coordinate.origins: fixed declared reference origins or moderate zero origins; not unknowns
coordinate.corrections: derived high+low covariance, preserve both in cancellation-sensitive differences, not unknowns

acceptance.natural_moments: max(1,abs(current),abs(target)); conditional moments unweighted by label mass; independent symmetric covariance entries
acceptance.properness: all active aggregates and tilts proper, residual and both objectives finite, unchanged support

directions: simultaneous quotient and auxiliary-target coordinate update
if all fixed-point trials fail, matrix-free CGLS Gauss-Newton step then identical backtracking
strategy.linear_target: sqrt(eps)*initial_normal_residual_norm; zero or unresolved curvature stops the linear solve without a convergence claim
strategy.linearization: one jax.linearize of the complete signed residual with frozen scales and coordinate scales; jax.linear_transpose of this same JVP; never scalar certificates or optimizer history
strategy.residual_scales: frozen per accepted coordinate: natural and conditional max(1,abs(current),abs(target)), unit label mass, 1+abs(xi); same scales for derivative and every trial
strategy.coordinate_scales: 1+abs(accepted coordinate); linear unknown is step divided by this scale
strategy.merit: sum(square(signed complete residual/frozen residual scales))/2; rectangular M residuals, N unknowns
strategy.xi_boundary: first trial fraction shortened to the nonnegative xi boundary; subsequent halves stay feasible
strategy.internal_target: tau(dtype); stable unchanged re-evaluation permitted only when every other exact certificate passes
strategy.failure: invalid initialization/accepted value -> diverged; no accepted direction, stationary nonzero residual or finite outer budget -> exhausted; invalid trials rejected with counted reason

starts.raw_zero: All packed message coefficients exactly zero, all active squared xi equal the named start. No feasible sweep.
starts.feasible: one simultaneous quotient sweep from unary cavities at chosen xi; invalid tilt diverges before iteration; inactive xi forced zero
starts.perturbed: after feasible initializer add 0.01*sin(arange(message_size)+1) to packed message coefficients only, xi unchanged; certify feasibility explicitly
starts.checks: Store each initial State and unpacked natural messages/xi before a solve. Failed initialization stops the sequence before an optimizer call. Signed messages are not clamped.

comparison.metric: max(abs(a-b)/(1+maximum(abs(a),abs(b)))) on each floating output leaf, then maximum by group
comparison.pairs: All 15 pairs of the six starts at each horizon; 30 pairs total.
comparison.policy: A material difference is a disclosure/diagnosis flag, not a universal uniqueness requirement. A3WZ must diagnose flagged stationary outputs before a positive checkpoint.

storage.logical: Abstract evaluation of actual parameter/metadata/coordinate/evaluation/derivative/linear/trial/outer/terminal trees, including retained low words and integer limbs. Logical bytes can double-count aliases.
storage.wide: T100 K20 d10 uses abstract parameter descriptors and identity unary placeholders for shapes only; it is not an extension of the fixed numerical formula or a solve.
storage.caps: Outer 400 and linear 256 are independently doubled memory-only variants. Complete solves must be compiled for the outer comparison. All storage executables have zero calls.
storage.program: All context and initial vector/State arguments are dynamic ShapeDtypeStruct leaves; only support/origin/index metadata and budgets are captured.
storage.forbidden: No dense global Jacobian, trajectory covariance, path enumeration, or iteration-history arrays. All derivative captures come only from one accepted local evaluation. Limits are explicit outer/trial/linear caps above.
storage.inventory_process: A separate shape-only child precedes the ten compilation children, so wide abstract tracing does not contaminate any compiled variant process peak. It has zero complete-program lower/compile/execute calls.

logical_contract.meaning: Complete native-float32 abstract leaf descriptors bound to producer source hashes, runtime versions and tracing configuration. Prospective setup artifact only; zero complete-program lower/compile/execute calls. Regenerate and update this hash if a producer changes before qualification.

runtime.persistent_cache: disabled via config; XLA auxiliary caches disabled; record actual settings and compiler logs
runtime.processes: Sequential fresh child per horizon for solves (six starts share retained initializer and complete-solve executables); a separate shape-only inventory child and ten fresh storage-variant children. Stop on first failure, resource stop or nonconvergence. No repeat, warm-up or recovery fit.
runtime.reuse: Retain Lowered and Compiled during each child. Initialization and solve are separately compiled. Never claim cross-child reuse or reuse of the historical compile-only executables.
runtime.timing: Separate lower, compile acquisition, input synchronization, first authorized call and block_until_ready. Serialization, readout conversion and initialization are outside the solve timer; report their times separately.
runtime.memory: XLA estimates separate from logical leaves and process memory; parent os.wait4 child ru_maxrss gives independent process high-water (Darwin bytes, Linux KiB). ps rss is a sampled current-RSS diagnostic in KiB, not a phase peak.
runtime.internal_dtypes: Actual input/initial/result/readout leaves plus fixed metadata, abstract storage leaves and all StableHLO values must be float32; statuses/masks/limbs stay integer or bool.
runtime.cache_evidence: Record compiler logs and actual disabled settings. Each solve child lowers and compiles initialization once and the complete solve once, retaining both executables for six authorized calls apiece. Each storage child lowers and compiles one complete variant once with zero executable calls. The separate logical-inventory child has zero complete-program lower/compile/execute calls. These counts do not establish cold acquisition: OS/compiler internals may reuse resources. No warm-up, repeat timing solve or cross-child executable reuse is claimed.

limits.rationale: Compiler limits inherit the independent PR147 preflight. A horizon child allows one hour for setup, two compilations and six bounded solves; the numerical budgets are unchanged. These are diagnostic resource stops, not permission to retry.

reports.payload: Immutable NPZ snapshots for every initial and terminal State, natural messages/xi, all beliefs with low words and physical readouts, and every centered/physical source-conditioned learning group. Exact leaf manifests carry shapes/dtypes/elements/bytes/SHA256.
reports.identity: Spec, source manifest, git revision and cleanliness, fixture content hashes, Python/JAX/jaxlib/NumPy/platform/configuration, cache/compiler logs, process peaks, timing and compilation call counts.
reports.failure: Keep the first failure and every preceding case, raw inputs, initialized coordinate/status and any returned terminal outputs, including nonfinite values as NPZ values. No rewriting previous reports/hashes. Incomplete reports cannot qualify.
reports.policy: Require complete twelve-case solve report and complete ten-case compiled storage report at the same source/spec, all numerical gates, and reviewed initialization sensitivity for A3WZ. Setup or compilation alone does not qualify.
reports.prospective_revision: Corrected after independent setup review, before first execution: cache/process counts, complete logical contracts and reconstructed numerical relationships. Original unexecuted specification at commit 7add5e58a1d18fdcc4e4d663053ea1ffdc131e97 has SHA256 6ab49430b1fcb752676e1d7cf8f487fee539f9a43abbebdc4f4601c0c41e51ea. Prior immutable evidence and manifests remain unchanged.

scope.authorized_here: Implementation and focused checks only; commit and pause for independent review.
scope.after_review: New immutable source-matched tiny evidence if source manifest changes. Root owns final short suite and publication. A3WZ owns actual moderate solve/storage execution and decision.
scope.unchanged: No approximation/scope/threshold changes, public compiler/Engine activation, no-learning semantics or registered source-recovery fits. K6G5/7SW5/X0IF retain opt-in and compilation/functionality trade-offs.
